name: GE® 33" 18.6 Cu. Ft. Fingerprint Resistant Stainless Steel Counter Depth French Door Refrigerator
shortDescription: Easily wipe away smudges and fingerprints for a look that's always sparkling clean. Offers a built-in look by fitting nearly flush with surrounding cabinetry. Delivers filtered water with one touch.

features.text: Fingerprint Resistant Stainless
Easily wipe away smudges and fingerprints for a look that's always sparkling clean
33" width
A compact design fits in smaller spaces, yet still offers the large storage capacity of a French-door refrigerator
Counter-depth design
Offers a built-in look by fitting nearly flush with surrounding cabinetry
Internal water dispenser
Easily access filtered water with the press of a button from an internal filtered water dispenser, while maintaining a clean and simple exterior.
Factory-Installed Icemaker with Water Filtration
Refrigerator comes ready to automatically create filtered ice cubes.
LED lighting
Find exactly what you’ve been looking for under crisp, clear lighting
Two humidity-controlled drawers and full-width drawer
Create the right environment for keeping fruits and vegetables fresh, while easily storing wider items like a party platter or a sheet cake
Two-Level Freezer Storage Drawers
Two freezer drawers that give bagged frozen items a place of their own, making it easier to sort, store, and find exactly what you need.
Quick Space shelf
Quickly slides out of the way to make room for tall items like your fresh batch of pink lemonade.
Spill-proof shelves
From tipped-over juice to dripping food containers, spill-proof shelves help prevent liquids from spreading, making cleanup quick and easy.
Gallon door storage
Deep bins handle large containers in the door and free up valuable shelf space
Advanced water filtration

The included refrigerator water filter reduces 50+ impurities including lead, chlorine, microplastics, and PFOA/PFOS; providing clean, safe drinking water and ice (replacement water filters sold separately - check refrigerator filter compartment for compatible model)
Turbo Cool and Turbo Freeze settings
An extra boost of cold air restores interior to set temperature for optimum food freshness
Door alarm
Enjoy peace of mind knowing the refrigerator door is never left open
Internal controls with actual-temperature display
Moving the temperature controls to the fresh food section gives you a modern exterior.
Enhanced Shabbos Mode
The Shabbos Keeper connects to your refrigerator to automatically enable Shabbos compatible modes each week and before every holiday
Adjustable Glass Shelves
Shelves have multiple adjustability points which flex to your needs and make it easier to organize.
